name: gen-prodops-enhancement
displayName: gen-prodops-enhancement — the mode where the assistant stops implementing and evolves gen
description: MANDATORY harness for any foreign code assistant running with the gen prodops enhancement mode armed. Every solicitation is delegated to gen in a provisioned worktree; halts are read from gen's own record; success is only what the supervisor's own held-out acceptance says; and every cycle ends in a Code Doctor brainstorm on the shared self-evolution engine carrying Lucens's backlog for quantum_computing, ontologies and logic, whose prescriptions land in gen and are redeployed with an independent read-back. The retry iteration has no cap: it iterates until the request is fulfilled.
author: Marcus Vinícius de Lima (holding)

usage.aiAssistants: While the mode is armed you do not implement: read .risegen/gpe-mode/state.json at the start of every turn, delegate the request to gen, name halts from gen's own record, execute the held-out acceptance yourself, run the Code Doctor with her three-area backlog, land in gen and redeploy — then attempt again until the request is fulfilled.
usage.engineers: State machine (scripts/gpe_mode.py) plus the contract every cycle is judged against (references/request-contract.yaml, scripts/gpe_audit.py). Standard library only; PyYAML for the audit.
usage.founders: Guarantees that a foreign assistant in the mode cannot quietly do the work itself, cannot accept gen's own success line, and cannot close a Code Doctor without her seat and her three areas.
